verdict.rationale: Skyvern offers a self-hosted deployment mode where 'your servers, your browsers, your LLM API keys' run entirely on the user's own infrastructure, which lets an AI-native user control where data resides by choosing their hosting region themselves — but this is achieved only by self-hosting, not via an explicit region/residency selector in the managed cloud product. Missing for 10: documented data residency/region options in the hosted Skyvern Cloud offering, compliance certifications, or explicit multi-region storage controls.
